headline: Meta’s Muse Charm looks like a Tamagotchi, but it’s tapping into a much newer trend
context: Meta’s new AI gadget may look like a Tamagotchi, but its dangling form factor taps into a much broader Gen Z trend around bag charms, retro tech, and turning gadgets into fashion accessories.
